title: Om Jai Jagdish
desc: Three brothers put aside their differences to join forces and save their ancestral home from being auctioned, resolving their family's legacy and their own personal issues.

title: Tumsa Nahin Dekha: A Love Story
desc: A drunk millionaire falls for Jia, a street dancer, but risks losing his fortune if he refuses to marry Anahita, forcing him to choose between love and inheritance.

title: Ghayal
desc: Ajay, wrongfully framed by Balwant Rai, teams up with fellow convicts for a thrilling quest for revenge. Together, they plot to reclaim his life and settle the score.

title: Narsimha
desc: A powerful divine being rises to stop a cruel ruler and protect a faithful child. The story highlights courage, justice, and the strength of true belief.

title: Don - The Chase Begins Again
desc: Vijay, a lookalike of crime lord Don, is recruited to uncover his secrets. When the officer guiding him dies, Vijay is trapped in a deadly maze, struggling to prove his true identity.

title: The Kerala Story 2: Goes Beyond
desc: Three women choose love over family expectations, but their dreams soon turn into hardship. Their journeys reveal how trust can become a path to loss and control.

title: Antim : The Final Truth
desc: A poor farmer's son rises in the city as a fearless gangster, but his reign is challenged when an unyielding cop steps in, sparking a fierce battle of power and justice.

title: Vijaypath
desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

title: Crook
desc: Jai, a small-time crook equipped with a new identity, is sent to Australia by his uncle. However, there he gets embroiled in the ongoing racial conflict while also trying to pursue his love interest.

title: Bharat
desc: During the India-Pakistan partition, Bharat is separated from his family and left to care for those who remain. He spends his life trying to uphold the promise he made to his father.

title: Uunchai
desc: Three retired friends trek to Everest Base Camp to honour their dying friend's wish. Along the way, they discover freedom, friendship, and the deeper meaning of life.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Aitraaz
desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Rajeev marries Roopa, a beautiful singer, but he struggles to accept her when he discovers her disfigured face, causing emotional pain and conflict in their relationship.

title: Sniff
desc: Sunny Gill, born without smell, gains superpowers after a lab accident enhances his senses. He transforms into a superhero, discovering strength and purpose in his new identity.
